scenario: Hex, binary, and octal integer literals per LLEX.11.1 — INT_LIT supports 0x, 0b, 0o prefixes. Pin: a where clause using hex (0xFF), binary (0b1010), and octal (0o17) literals compiles correctly.
rules_ds:
schema Flags scope logical:
    mask: Int key

rule r:
    Flags f where f.mask == 0xFF or f.mask == 0b11111111 or f.mask == 0o377
->
    log info "full mask"
